page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top right. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: singulis bellè præcinunt, easdemque in semisses dividunt, cum voluptate civium, & peregrinorum audientium. Et secundùm hæc tria templa tota civitas in tres fuit distincta parochias. Nunc Walburgica Martinianæ addita est, & ex tribus duæ fa-ctæ. Ex monasticis amplif-simum Franciscanum cum cœnobio spatioso in urbis ferè medio; quod cœnobium jam scholæ literariæ sedes est toti civitati communis: alterum Jacobæum cum cœnobio monachorum Dominicanorum in boreo urbis latere ad ipsa mœnia, breuissimo intervallo dissitum ab area, in qua Walburgicum & Martinianum: Tertium monachorum, quos Fratres nuncupabant, modicum, item cum cœnobio in angulo areæ ejusdem Walburgicæ boreo, ac in latere urbis eodem, mœnibus etiam contiguum; id cœnobium ante triginta circiter annos in sedem & aulam Knifiii primi & postre-mi Episcopi Groningani versum; deinde Gubernatoris provinciæ domicilium fa-ctum: quem usum etiam nunc præstat: quartum monialium sororum S. Claræ

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment, the end of a sentence from the previous page ("singulis", transcribed as singulis). The word "fa-ctum" is printed with a line-end hyphen, and "amplif-simum", "spa-tioso", "cœnobi-um", "Dominica-", "Martinia-", "eo-", "civi-" and "postre-mi" are also split at line ends. The long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. The catchword "cum" is at the right below the last line.
